coverage.method: Selected data/eligibility -> runtime execution -> record or actual consequence. Overlapping DDA achievement/conduct paths share the attributed event engine. Not whole-repository coverage.

prior_review.delta: New pins and new traced subsystems. Prior review is a baseline, not current behavior proof. Current YAIR now has finite stock bands and independent lessons/work, so prior missing-consumer claims are not repeated as live gaps.

findings.observed: Rune pickup sets a distinct-rune bit and supplies collection messaging; pickup milestones separately identify collectibles. Default Zot access requires three runes (descent mode differs). Dungeon exit classifies a run as winning only with the Orb, otherwise leaving. Default score combines modified experience, rune count, gems and an extra rune/turn term for winners; it does not award carried inventory value. End-game writes score and logfile, excluding wizard/explore by default. Custom sprint score may override the default.
findings.limits: No formal general in-client achievement catalogue established by this path. Server tournament banners, external accounts and all branch generation are outside review. Score tuning and player behavior were not exercised.
findings.prior_delta: RB-POW-02 inspected casting risk, not hard collection/access/win/score paths. New revision is explicitly different; no old spell evidence silently upgraded.
findings.smallest_original_application: Retain an earned local feat receipt for completing a field goal by a recorded route, then show it beside existing finite endings. Optional harder criteria can deepen the same campaign without a new world or reset.
findings.inference: A completion record should describe what was done and with what constraints. Importing numerical high-score pressure would be a separate design choice.

findings.observed: Entangling is a weighted weapon brand and a polearm-related choice. A successful brand branch rolls coinflip and checks can_constrict before storing attacker/victim IDs and hold type. A resistant or already-held victim is excluded; entangling requires reach and at most one entangling target. Hold validity depends on actual actor life, line of sight and range; moving farther away can break direct holds. Continuing damage applies half-AC handling, timescale and hurt/death consequences. Sanctuary releases holds. Constriction IDs/type are serialized.
findings.limits: This is one brand path, not full item generation or damage balance. No general wet-electricity interaction is inferred. YAIR arena has no DCSS tile geometry, so spatial holds are poor first fit.
findings.prior_delta: Adds a concrete actor-linked ongoing effect and release lifecycle beyond casting failure.
findings.yair_disposition: covered core; new consumer for persistent hold
findings.smallest_original_application: Prefer one short actual-defense opening in the existing battle before attempting a persistent tether. If later selected, a hold must name actor/target/source, capacity, escape and termination; a label alone is insufficient.
findings.inference: Source-linked termination matters more than copying the vines or adding a generic damage-over-time status.

findings.observed: Automatic training weights recent exercise queues; manual training weights enabled/focused skills. Exercise changes weights, rather than independently creating unlimited skill XP. train_skills distributes available XP, with actual point cost debited and manual bonus points consumed. The player may set a base or modified skill target within 0..27, subject to trainability. Reaching a target clears it, disables training and announces the result. Skill points and both targets serialize. Species/mutation cases alter training policy.
findings.limits: DCSS has a finite level ceiling and pooled XP. Neither policy is recommended for YAIR. Cross-training and every skill function were not traced.
findings.prior_delta: New training allocation/target/record path; prior casting evidence used skill as an input, not this training lifecycle.
findings.smallest_original_application: Stop a funded practice plan after a chosen functional band is earned and explain the newly available function. Reuse current method/mastery owner and finite work plan rather than adding pooled XP.
findings.inference: A chosen stopping goal can make active-to-idle practice purposeful; no universal cap or skill substitution is implied.

findings.observed: An achievement specifies statistic comparisons, optional time bounds and visibility/hiding. Monster death emits an attributed character_kills_monster event for non-hallucinations; summoner attribution is possible. Avatar-ID and species transformations filter those events before the zombie count. Statistic watchers update requirements; satisfying all requirements with a completed time condition records completion once, stores turn/current values and removes the live tracker. Callback emits player_gets_achievement and configurable notices. Status/initial IDs serialize, and a separate completed-ID/avatar record supports past achievements. The reviewed callback does not grant combat power or item rewards.
findings.limits: No full catalogue audit, event latency test, migration test or exploit/kill-attribution audit. Large count ladders and minute deadlines are examples, not recommended YAIR pacing.
findings.prior_delta: RB-LIV-01/02/03 covered teacher offers, proficiency and authored mission work, not achievement statistics/watchers/records.
findings.yair_disposition: new consumer for qualified cross-action accomplishment view; existing receipts covered
findings.smallest_original_application: Add a few original earned feats projected from committed current-owner facts and an immutable completion receipt. Avoid a second event bus or generic kill treadmill.
findings.inference: Source separates cosmetic recognition from power reward, allowing accomplishments without automatic stat inflation.

findings.observed: No-attacks and no-kills are different conducts: one checks melee/ranged attack events, the other attributed death counts. A conduct is not granted as a normal positive achievement when its requirements remain satisfied. A monotonic requirement becoming false records failure once; conduct failure callback emits a distinct event and notice. Tracker status persists.
findings.limits: Reviewed through the shared kill-event path, not every attack or death attribution. Global no-kill rules include indirect attribution and cannot be assumed to mean only player button presses. No account reward for intact conduct was established.
findings.prior_delta: Adds negative historical conditions and irreversible failure records, distinct from proficiency thresholds.
findings.smallest_original_application: An opt-in local route certificate could require resolving the sluice without strikes after enrollment. It records completed, violated or withdrawn separately; ordinary passage and prior earned progress remain available.
findings.inference: One bounded contract is preferable to policing the entire save or retroactively judging earlier actions.

findings.observed: Aikido data defines skill-gated static tiers and a one-turn on-block move-cost buff. Runtime requirements inspect buffs, armedness/style-weapon compatibility, skill and character flags. simultaneous_add first checks every candidate against the same pre-application state, then applies effects. Native block resolution spends stamina and dispatches on-block effects; timed ma_buff effects feed attack-cost calculation. On-block buff is triggered by a block event, not simply possessing a style.
findings.limits: No full technique-selection audit, combat session or balance claim. Static-tier descriptions do not prove all combat outcomes. Buff application is actual effect state/consequence; persistence of every transient combat buff was not separately audited.
findings.prior_delta: New data-to-native-combat effect consumer, rather than prior teaching/proficiency interface.
findings.yair_disposition: covered structural pattern; extension for earned defensive opportunity
findings.smallest_original_application: After a real redirected or blocked attempt, offer one lower-cost retreat or counter window. The chosen event must be confirmed from the native strike outcome, with a single consumption/expiry rule.
findings.inference: Current YAIR already has guards, actual gear, fatigue counters, read/track openings and method bands. A new broad martial-art engine would duplicate it.

findings.observed: Hydraulics practice declares skill bounds, plumbing proficiency, one hour, tool qualities, a charged reusable kit and a book source. Runtime practice difficulty clamps to declared bounds; its skill cap is skill_limit minus one. Start checks required proficiencies/character requirements and available recipe inputs. Craft progress debits required resources and tools before skill gain; skill and proficiency gains occur during work. Qualified helpers gain different skill practice, and another crafter who knows a proficiency can double proficiency learning. Practice completion creates no product. Ordinary referenced crafting has a separate probabilistic recipe-memorization path.
findings.limits: Proficiency practice/persistence itself was already reviewed in RB-LIV-02. Recipe availability/memorization and all helper selection are partial context, not a new full trace of NPC autonomy. No free output is implied by practice.
findings.prior_delta: Adds actual recipe/tool/progress/output distinctions and helper learning context to the prior proficiency API finding.
findings.smallest_original_application: Keep drill, productive craft and teacher lesson as separate actions. Current sealing practice advances owned mastery while producing real paid goods; Vale has independent paid teaching and demonstration. No extra global curriculum engine is justified by this review.
findings.inference: Useful distinction is what work can teach and what it actually produces, rather than another practice bar.

recommendations.title: Keep a small earned-feat record beside the existing endings
recommendations.classification: new consumer using existing durable outcomes
recommendations.player_goal_choice: Complete one local field accomplishment by a selected route, then optionally meet a harder constraint. Example proposal: restore the floodline with actual protected supplies and preserve the courier’s stock.
recommendations.early_late_repeat: Early completion records the route and useful result; later mastery permits a distinct improved solution. Revisit past receipts after renewal or a rematch without repeating rewards.
recommendations.reward_aftermath: Existing route, stock, relationship and skill effects remain the reward. A readable dated feat receipt preserves the accomplishment; no automatic stat bonus.
recommendations.current_qualification: Finite endings, actor facts, completed counters, result knowledge and battle lastReceipt already exist. event_feed is recent news, not a persistent qualified accomplishment catalogue; last battle fields can be overwritten.
recommendations.integration_cost: Medium: small versioned definition/projection layer and receipt lifetime policy at existing durable publisher. Do not infer success from preview, count polling or scrape prose.
recommendations.later_playable_gate: A committed successful goal appears once with its method/cause; preview, failed settlement and repeat visits cannot award it. Existing aftermath stays useful. A generated save/reload retains the same receipt and unknown feats remain hidden.
recommendations.compatibility: Any new saved receipt field needs explicit optional-schema/default and retention/migration policy; old private saves are not touched during research.

recommendations.title: Offer one voluntary local conduct challenge
recommendations.player_goal_choice: Before a new sluice attempt, choose a certificate challenge such as secure passage without making a strike, using support, objective work or the longer walk. Enrollment makes the scope and prohibited actions explicit.
recommendations.early_late_repeat: Ordinary completion comes first; a later prepared player can attempt a more demanding approach with mature methods. Attempt IDs allow a new challenge without erasing an earlier violation.
recommendations.reward_aftermath: Recorded certificate or honest violated/withdrawn attempt; an authored local recognition response only if a witness/report actually reaches the resident. Passage reward is still granted by existing route rules.
recommendations.current_qualification: Battle receipts and lastActions exist, but no saved optional conduct enrollment/violation contract was found in these owners. Current nonlethal battles cannot certify literal no-kills as a meaningful extra goal.
recommendations.integration_cost: Medium: exact enrollment/attempt scope and violation flag set by the committed action, then settled at the existing outcome boundary. No global action telemetry or retroactive conduct system.
recommendations.later_playable_gate: Enroll, preview a strike without violation, then commit a strike and see one durable violation. Complete an eligible non-strike route on another attempt; decline/withdraw remains available and grants no certificate. Save/reload preserves attempt identity and ordinary passage works either way.
recommendations.compatibility: New optional records require an explicit schema/absent default; enrollment does not judge the prior save or impose a universal rule.

recommendations.title: Earn a short retreat opening from actual defense
recommendations.player_goal_choice: Spend a guard or release-pressure response, then choose between the earned one-action retreat discount and a counter opportunity after the actual defended strike.
recommendations.early_late_repeat: Ordinary defense permits a narrow exit; mature learned control may widen target support or efficiency. Fixed opponent equipment and anchoring still affect whether it works.
recommendations.reward_aftermath: Reduced cost or one concrete retreat step only after the qualifying event. Wounds, spent stock and helper fatigue remain; no passive permanent buff.
recommendations.current_qualification: Current sluice code already has guard consumption, redirect fatigue, anchored resistance, track/read openings, escape progress, actual hook gear and cause-bearing receipts. Add only one missing event-to-next-choice consumer. Full spatial tether/constriction remains poor fit without movement/reach consumers.
recommendations.integration_cost: Low to medium for one battle-state token, but exact blocked/hit/evaded trigger and action lifetime must be authored. High for importing DCSS spatial holds; exclude that larger system.
recommendations.later_playable_gate: A qualifying actual defense exposes the window once; an evasion, failed guard, unsupported helper or merely selecting the method does not. Use or expire it, then verify no free repeated discount and anchoring still applies. Generated save/reload retains or explicitly clears it according to the declared battle policy.
recommendations.compatibility: Battle schema/version decision belongs to its current runtime owner; no generic status engine is selected.

recommendations.title: Let a practice plan stop at a useful functional milestone
recommendations.player_goal_choice: Choose a specific next method function, see its real cost/prerequisite, and run funded known practice only until that band or a finite maximum is reached.
recommendations.early_late_repeat: Early single-target control leads to current higher mastery functions; later plans can aim at the next supported function without erasing the earlier path. The same skill remains useful.
recommendations.reward_aftermath: Existing method mastery/function and paid products, with a stopped-plan receipt and visible newly legal action. No transferred pooled XP or universal level cap.
recommendations.current_qualification: Current power models already support masteryBands; feature methods have mature functions and work plans have finite steps/paused reasons. Repository sealing and Vale’s independent demonstration cover practice/work distinction. The proposed delta is goal-based stopping and function-oriented plan display, not a new training engine.
recommendations.integration_cost: Low for an authored finite plan using current completion counts; medium only if persistent generic goal predicates are actually needed. Prefer existing finite plan first.
recommendations.later_playable_gate: Select one declared band, complete funded jobs and see the actual function become legal. Plan stops before an unnecessary new reservation; loss of tools/source pauses honestly; preview/cancellation does not add mastery. Save/reload preserves funded active work and the stopping goal.
recommendations.compatibility: No new skill economy. Any generic saved target requires explicit optional versioning; current plan/definition support must remain available.

No automatic NPC recognition from player achievement; reports and witnesses retain existing knowledge rules.
